new_regression.name: dense_large_files_distinguish_changes_outside_spaced_samples
new_regression.cases: ordinary and verified scan, forward and reversed roots; exactly authored original/copy group, no issues/aliases, all3files observed

limits: Focused no-default-features test target only; not whole workspace or all features.
Dense authored66MiB logical payloads fully scanned; filesystem copy may use clone/reflink and no physical allocation measurement claimed.
Other three cases qualify u64 admission/discovery and bounded cancellation of sparse large files, not full multi-GiB equality.
No throughput claim; shared machine had concurrent work.
